checks.title: Single-valued relationship carries two values
checks.description: An entity carries two values for a relationship the agreed pattern allows one of, typically because two mappings each contribute a link and disagree. Reported by a project check because the ontology does not declare the property functional.
checks.remediation: Establish which source is authoritative and drop the other mapping's triple. Declaring the property owl:FunctionalProperty afterwards moves the check to LOG-002.
checks.cucumber_scenario: A single-valued relationship has one value
